nodes.note: VERIFY a badge — checking a badge is real. Anyone, in any browser, with no login and no server. This box shows everything that act needs.
nodes.label:
① VERIFY a badge
(any browser)

nodes.note: The Badge — one signed token that IS the credential (skill, gates, embedded attestations, NDC seal). It's the source of truth; verifying it needs nothing but the badge and the math.
nodes.label: Badge (signed JWT)

nodes.note: Ed25519 / did:key — the cryptography everything rests on. Ed25519 is the signature scheme; a did:key is a public identity built from that key. Verifying a badge needs only this and the badge.
nodes.label: Ed25519 / did:key

nodes.note: The whole point of VERIFY: its closure is just the badge and the math. No server, no registry, no proxy needed to trust a badge.
nodes.label: no server · no registry · no proxy

nodes.note: SIGN a gate attestation — a person putting their own cryptographic name on what happened at a gate. This box shows everything that act needs.
nodes.label: ② SIGN a gate attestation

nodes.note: sodoto-sign.html — where a person signs an attestation for one gate (See / Do / Teach). It loads their key and produces a signed token proving THEY attested; if the key isn't on this device, they restore it from their recovery file + passphrase.
nodes.label: sodoto-sign.html

nodes.note: The person's self-custodied identity — a did:key (a public name built from an Ed25519 key pair). The private half stays on this device; the public half verifies their signatures.
nodes.label:
my did:key
(private key on device)

nodes.note: Ed25519 — the signature scheme every SODOTO signature uses. Signing needs the private key; verifying needs only the public key (carried in the DID).
nodes.label: Ed25519

nodes.note: Your recovery route — an encrypted recovery file (safe to keep anywhere, even the cloud) plus your passphrase, unlocked by sodoto-crypto.js. Together they restore your key on a new device.
nodes.label:
recovery file + passphrase
+ sodoto-crypto.js

nodes.note: ONBOARD — creating a brand-new SODOTO identity for a person. This box shows everything that act needs.
nodes.label: ③ ONBOARD (mint identity)

nodes.note: sodoto-onboard.html — the page a new person opens to create their identity. It makes an Ed25519 signing key in their browser, locks a recovery copy with their passphrase, and shows their public name (DID). Nothing is sent anywhere.
nodes.label: sodoto-onboard.html

nodes.note: WebCrypto — the browser's built-in crypto engine. Here it generates the Ed25519 identity key and uses AES-GCM to lock the recovery file with the passphrase.
nodes.label:
WebCrypto
Ed25519 + AES-GCM

nodes.note: sodoto-crypto.js — shared code that locks and unlocks the private key with a passphrase (encrypt on onboarding, decrypt on restore). It's how you recover your identity on another device.
nodes.label: sodoto-crypto.js

nodes.note: Your passphrase — a phrase you remember. It locks and unlocks your recovery file so you can restore your identity elsewhere. It never leaves your browser.
nodes.label: your passphrase

nodes.note: ISSUE / SEAL a badge — turning completed, signed gates into a finished credential the NDC vouches for. Notice how much larger this closure is than VERIFY's.
nodes.label: ④ ISSUE / SEAL a badge

nodes.note: sodoto-issuer.html — the coordinator's tool. It registers people, records each gate, collects everyone's signed attestations, then seals the finished credential with the NDC key and writes the badge to the portfolio.
nodes.label: sodoto-issuer.html

nodes.note: Attestation JWTs — the signed statements each party makes at a gate: the learner ('I did it'), the mentor ('I witnessed it'), and at Teach One the student ('I was taught'). Each is a signature no one else can forge.
nodes.label:
Attestation JWTs
(learner+mentor+student)

nodes.note: The NDC signing key — the cooperative's private Ed25519 key. Signing a credential with it is the institution's seal: 'this NDC vouches the gates were completed.'
nodes.label: NDC signing key

nodes.note: people-registry — the list of who's enrolled: name, public DID, and portfolio page. The coordinator reads and updates it; sofi-proxy serves it.
nodes.label: people-registry

nodes.note: sofi-proxy — the small server that hands out the browser tools and writes finished badges into the wiki on the browser's behalf (a web page can't write wiki files directly). It also runs the demo seed.
nodes.label:
sofi-proxy
(wiki write API)

nodes.note: FedWiki — the wiki that hosts the portfolio pages and badges and renders each badge so anyone can view and verify it.
nodes.label:
FedWiki
(stores the badge)

nodes.note: Ed25519 — the signature scheme every SODOTO signature uses. Signing needs the private key; verifying needs only the public key (carried in the DID).
nodes.label: Ed25519

nodes.note: Why ISSUE's closure is really even bigger: each attestation it collects was itself produced by the entire SIGN closure.
nodes.label: each attestation ⊇ the SIGN closure (②)

nodes.note: DEPLOY — building the container images and running them on the server. This is a build/run dependency, kept separate from the runtime ones.
nodes.label: ⑤ DEPLOY (build / run)

nodes.note: sofi-proxy — the small server that hands out the browser tools and writes finished badges into the wiki on the browser's behalf (a web page can't write wiki files directly). It also runs the demo seed.
nodes.label:
rcn-sodoto-proxy image
⊇ sofi-proxy + tools + seed

nodes.note: FedWiki — the wiki that hosts the portfolio pages and badges and renders each badge so anyone can view and verify it.
nodes.label:
rcn-sodoto-wiki image
⊇ FedWiki + badge plugin

nodes.note: GHCR (GitHub Container Registry) — the public shelf where the built container images are stored. Marc pushes images here; the server pulls them from here to run.
nodes.label: GHCR

nodes.note: Caddy — the front-door web server that provides HTTPS (the padlock) and routes each web address to the right container. Not SODOTO-specific; just secure traffic.
nodes.label: Caddy — HTTPS

nodes.note: WikiCafe — the server (run by Christian) that pulls the images from GHCR and runs the live SODOTO system over HTTPS.
nodes.label: WikiCafe (pulls)
